notebooklm.finding: NotebookLM still lives at notebooklm.google.com; renamed 'Gemini Notebook' in July 2026. Already listed in the catalog under Artificial Intelligence > AI summarization and document analysis, so not re-added.
notebooklm.free_tier_verified: Google account required, no credit card; 100 notebooks/user, 50 sources/notebook (up to 500k words or 200MB each), ~50 chat queries/day (shifting to compute-based limits refreshing every 5h under a weekly ceiling), 3 Audio Overviews/day, 3 Video Overviews/day, 10 each Reports/Flashcards/Quizzes/Mind Maps per day, 10 Deep Research runs/month; watermark removal only on Ultra tier.
